semantics.contact: unmodified live contacts retained from the original completed mj_step; not recomputed
semantics.time: step input/output bracket; contact geometry evaluation precedes integration, while output qpos is post-integration
semantics.state: mjSTATE_INTEGRATION pre/post: time, qpos, qvel, act/history, warmstart, ctrl, applied forces, eq_active, mocap, userdata, plugin
semantics.geometry: event geom_xpos/xmat and contact frame are copied directly from live evaluation arrays
semantics.events: all samples at depth >=0.19mm OR any obstacle new maximum; both pre/post state retained
semantics.force: normal force for the deepest retained pair of each obstacle, not sum across contacts
semantics.solver: stored first-island iteration diagnostics are not certified residual/error bounds
